Author Kamusi, Mohammed Al Firauzabadius librum

scripsisse ait, in quo cum 80 ejus nomina recensue-
rit, totam tamen ejus nomenclaturam non absolvisse

se in libro à se compósito enumerâsse. Certè in lin-

interim tamen aiunt quod reliquum est ejus, esse قليل
من كثير [?] parum admodum è multo. Nec

page.notes: Arabic words in the margin and in the text (جمل, سيف, قليل من كثير, الصحاح عن اهل العلم) are read from a small scan and are marked [?]. "Ebn Chalawaih" and "Ebn Chalican" are proper names read with doubt. "huperum" may be a misprint for a different word. "Mezh." in the last margin note is only partly legible and may be read wrongly. The Latin and Arabic parts of the note line "Kam. in" are not fully clear.
